statement: The Rice Ridge genomic-prediction model (rice_gs) ranks GRWT100 candidate lines with strong enrichment for high measured grain weight. On a 20-line stratified sample, top-12 model-ranked lines measured 3.1-5.0 g (mean 3.72) versus 1.2-2.7 g (mean 2.00) for mid/low-ranked controls; sampled Spearman rho=0.929. The top-10 selection is therefore drawn from the phenotyped top-12 and ordered by real measured GRWT100 (E3), with model prediction (E1) as tie-breaker.
limitations: Only 20 of 904 candidate lines were phenotyped (E3); the other 884 rankings are E1 predictions only, never measurements.

The 20-line sample was stratified (top/mid/low), so the sample Spearman 0.93 is inflated relative to the true pool-wide correlation (~0.45 per model card); it confirms enrichment, not a precise predictability estimate.
Single environment; no genotype-by-environment interaction, epistasis, or dominance modeled.
Predicted values are model outputs (E1), not measured phenotypes; rank-1 is not a guarantee of high quartile membership.
Quartile threshold was not directly observable; selection is based on measured enrichment of top-model lines.
